name: 45 degrees back extension scapular adduction
description: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.
instructions: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.
